name: opportunity-discovery-platform
description: Off-Campus Internship & Placement Opportunity Discovery Platform

scripts.build: npm run build -w @odp/shared && npm run build -w @odp/api && npm run build -w @odp/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @odp/api" "npm run dev -w @odp/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @odp/shared && npm run typecheck -w @odp/api && npm run typecheck -w @odp/web
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build -w @odp/shared && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
